label: BACnet/SC

bitrate_bps.label: Ethernet Link Speed
bitrate_bps.description: Underlying explicitly declared Ethernet link rate; BACnet/SC over TCP/TLS/WebSocket has no independent PHY bitrate.

default_review.source_revision: LAN9116 DS00002268B 2017 sections1.2/3.2/5.4; qualified10BASE-T baseline. TI DP83867 SNLS484J June2026; Broadcom BCM84918 rates

bitrate_bps.source_revision: Explicit Ethernet stack baseline; RFC 894 April 1984 10 Mbit/s

payload_bytes.label: Encoded BACnet APDU
payload_bytes.description: Encoded APDU; registered SC routing baseline NPDU <=61327, at least two NPCI bytes. Actual routed NPCI, BVLC options, peer APDU/NPDU limits and TCP/TLS/WebSocket framing remain separate. Not a 65535-byte APDU guarantee.

target_bus_load_percent.label: Ziel-Buslast
target_bus_load_percent.description: Zielwert fuer die aus Routing, Payload, Zyklus und Bitrate berechnete Buslast.

queue_policy.label: Queue Policy
queue_policy.description: Abstract NIS queue, not BACnet transaction state or guaranteed device processing.

mtu_bytes.label: MTU
mtu_bytes.description: Declared IPv4-over-Ethernet baseline link MTU. TCP segmentation permits SC messages spanning packets; not the BVLC, NPDU or APDU maximum. IPv6 requires its own explicit link profile.

duplex.label: Duplex
duplex.description: Actual declared Ethernet PHY mode; bidirectional WebSocket connections do not specify a full-duplex physical port.

bacnet_device_instance.label: Assigned BACnet device instance
bacnet_device_instance.description: Literature proposal or actual device/PICS configuration; saving does not execute BACnet or establish capacity.

bacnet_max_apdu_bytes.label: Actual accepted maximum APDU
bacnet_max_apdu_bytes.description: Actual accepted APDU size from device/PICS. SC can support more than 1476; registration uses the 61327-byte routed NPDU baseline minus minimum NPCI. No device size is assumed.

bacnet_segmentation.label: Actual device segmentation support
bacnet_segmentation.description: Literature proposal or actual device/PICS configuration; saving does not execute BACnet or establish capacity.
bacnet_segmentation.source_revision: Actual PICS; compile-time stack defaults are not device capabilities

bacnet_apdu_retries.label: Confirmed-service APDU retries
bacnet_apdu_retries.description: Literature proposal or actual device/PICS configuration; saving does not execute BACnet or establish capacity.

bacnet_apdu_timeout_modifiable.label: Device permits APDU timeout modification
bacnet_apdu_timeout_modifiable.description: Literature proposal or actual device/PICS configuration; saving does not execute BACnet or establish capacity.

bacnet_apdu_timeout_ms.label: Confirmed-service APDU timeout
bacnet_apdu_timeout_ms.description: Literature default: 3000 ms if modifiable, otherwise 60000 ms. Device property remains unknown until this condition is known. Must be nonzero when retries are nonzero.

bacnet_segment_timeout_ms.label: APDU segment timeout
bacnet_segment_timeout_ms.description: Literature proposal 2000 ms; applicable when segmentation is supported, not an application deadline. Actual device/PICS support is separate.

sc_connection_type.label: Connection purpose
sc_connection_type.description: SC-specific baseline or actual installation fact; not Annex J UDP/BBMD, Ethernet MTU, or executable security/capacity evidence.

sc_websocket_subprotocol.label: WebSocket subprotocol
sc_websocket_subprotocol.description: SC-specific baseline or actual installation fact; not Annex J UDP/BBMD, Ethernet MTU, or executable security/capacity evidence.

sc_primary_hub_uri.label: Actual primary hub WSS URI
sc_primary_hub_uri.description: Actual secure WebSocket URI. RFC 6455 default port is 443 when omitted; no universal BACnet/SC port 47808 or vendor 50050 is assumed.

sc_failover_hub_uri.label: Optional failover hub WSS URI
sc_failover_hub_uri.description: Actual secure WebSocket URI. RFC 6455 default port is 443 when omitted; no universal BACnet/SC port 47808 or vendor 50050 is assumed.

sc_direct_peer_uri.label: Actual direct peer WSS URI
sc_direct_peer_uri.description: Actual secure WebSocket URI. RFC 6455 default port is 443 when omitted; no universal BACnet/SC port 47808 or vendor 50050 is assumed.

sc_vmac_kind.label: Virtual address origin
sc_vmac_kind.description: SC-specific baseline or actual installation fact; not Annex J UDP/BBMD, Ethernet MTU, or executable security/capacity evidence.

sc_vmac.label: Actual node VMAC (12 hex digits)
sc_vmac.description: Actual individual EUI-48 or Random-48 address, never zero/broadcast. Random-48 low nibble of first octet is 2. Identity and collision checking are not invented.

sc_device_uuid.label: Persistent device UUID
sc_device_uuid.description: SC-specific baseline or actual installation fact; not Annex J UDP/BBMD, Ethernet MTU, or executable security/capacity evidence.

sc_accept_direct_connections.label: Actual direct connection acceptance capability
sc_accept_direct_connections.description: SC-specific baseline or actual installation fact; not Annex J UDP/BBMD, Ethernet MTU, or executable security/capacity evidence.

sc_peer_max_bvlc_bytes.label: Actual peer maximum BVLC message
sc_peer_max_bvlc_bytes.description: SC-specific baseline or actual installation fact; not Annex J UDP/BBMD, Ethernet MTU, or executable security/capacity evidence.

sc_peer_max_npdu_bytes.label: Actual peer maximum NPDU
sc_peer_max_npdu_bytes.description: SC-specific baseline or actual installation fact; not Annex J UDP/BBMD, Ethernet MTU, or executable security/capacity evidence.

sc_npdu_bytes.label: Actual encoded NPDU including APDU
sc_npdu_bytes.description: SC-specific baseline or actual installation fact; not Annex J UDP/BBMD, Ethernet MTU, or executable security/capacity evidence.

sc_npci_header_bytes.label: Actual NPCI octets for this APDU path
sc_npci_header_bytes.description: SC-specific baseline or actual installation fact; not Annex J UDP/BBMD, Ethernet MTU, or executable security/capacity evidence.

sc_bvlc_base_header_bytes.label: Actual BVLC header before options
sc_bvlc_base_header_bytes.description: SC-specific baseline or actual installation fact; not Annex J UDP/BBMD, Ethernet MTU, or executable security/capacity evidence.

sc_destination_options_bytes.label: Actual encoded destination options
sc_destination_options_bytes.description: SC-specific baseline or actual installation fact; not Annex J UDP/BBMD, Ethernet MTU, or executable security/capacity evidence.

sc_data_options_bytes.label: Actual encoded data options
sc_data_options_bytes.description: SC-specific baseline or actual installation fact; not Annex J UDP/BBMD, Ethernet MTU, or executable security/capacity evidence.

sc_reconnect_timeout_modifiable.label: Minimum reconnect timeout configurable
sc_reconnect_timeout_modifiable.description: SC-specific baseline or actual installation fact; not Annex J UDP/BBMD, Ethernet MTU, or executable security/capacity evidence.

sc_min_reconnect_s.label: Minimum reconnect interval
sc_min_reconnect_s.description: Lowest documented baseline proposal depends on actual configurability; no universal default is specified. A supported configurable range is not a device upper limit.

sc_max_reconnect_s.label: Actual maximum reconnect backoff
sc_max_reconnect_s.description: SC-specific baseline or actual installation fact; not Annex J UDP/BBMD, Ethernet MTU, or executable security/capacity evidence.

sc_connect_wait_s.label: Connect wait timeout
sc_connect_wait_s.description: Recommended standard default 10 s; configurable support must cover at least 5..300 s. 300 is not a universal upper device limit.

sc_disconnect_wait_s.label: Actual disconnect wait timeout
sc_disconnect_wait_s.description: SC-specific baseline or actual installation fact; not Annex J UDP/BBMD, Ethernet MTU, or executable security/capacity evidence.

sc_heartbeat_timeout_modifiable.label: Heartbeat timeout configurable
sc_heartbeat_timeout_modifiable.description: SC-specific baseline or actual installation fact; not Annex J UDP/BBMD, Ethernet MTU, or executable security/capacity evidence.

sc_heartbeat_s.label: Initiating peer heartbeat interval
sc_heartbeat_s.description: Lowest documented baseline proposal depends on actual configurability; no universal default is specified. A supported configurable range is not a device upper limit.

sc_accept_heartbeat_s.label: Actual accepting peer inactivity limit
sc_accept_heartbeat_s.description: SC-specific baseline or actual installation fact; not Annex J UDP/BBMD, Ethernet MTU, or executable security/capacity evidence.

sc_tls_version.label: Baseline TLS version
sc_tls_version.description: SC-specific baseline or actual installation fact; not Annex J UDP/BBMD, Ethernet MTU, or executable security/capacity evidence.

sc_mutual_tls_required.label: Mutual TLS authentication required
sc_mutual_tls_required.description: SC-specific baseline or actual installation fact; not Annex J UDP/BBMD, Ethernet MTU, or executable security/capacity evidence.

sc_cipher_suite.label: Required-to-implement TLS cipher suite
sc_cipher_suite.description: Mandatory baseline capability proposal; optional additional negotiated suites/algorithms need their own PICS profile. This field does not establish a TLS session.

sc_signature_algorithm.label: Required-to-implement signature algorithm
sc_signature_algorithm.description: Mandatory baseline capability proposal; optional additional negotiated suites/algorithms need their own PICS profile. This field does not establish a TLS session.

sc_key_exchange_group.label: Required-to-implement key exchange group
sc_key_exchange_group.description: Mandatory baseline capability proposal; optional additional negotiated suites/algorithms need their own PICS profile. This field does not establish a TLS session.

sc_operational_certificate_ref.label: Actual operational certificate reference
sc_operational_certificate_ref.description: SC-specific baseline or actual installation fact; not Annex J UDP/BBMD, Ethernet MTU, or executable security/capacity evidence.

sc_ca_store_ref.label: Actual trusted site CA store reference
sc_ca_store_ref.description: SC-specific baseline or actual installation fact; not Annex J UDP/BBMD, Ethernet MTU, or executable security/capacity evidence.
